description: Change who can open a Files document, folder, or artifact. Only its owner or a workspace admin can. Each access entry sets one audience: "team" (everyone in the project), "link" (anyone with the URL, signed in or not, which publishes the file), or a project member's email. A role of null removes that access given on this file; access inherited from a parent folder, such as a shared folder, stays and is listed under inherited. Audiences you do not list keep their access. All entries apply together or not at all. Returns who can open the file afterwards, including artifactUrl for an artifact.

access.description: Access to set. Audiences not listed keep their current access. Each audience or email appears once.

role.description: The access to give; null removes this audience's access.

to.description: Everyone who can open the file's project.

role.description: viewer or commenter; null turns the link off.

to.description: Anyone with the link, signed in or not. This publishes the file.

role.description: The access to give; null removes this audience's access.

to.description: The email of a person who can already open the project.
